sanskrit_verse:
uttare syāc caturthe tu sasākṣijayapatrakam /
ṛṇādikeṣu kāryeṣu kalpayen mānuṣīṃ kriyām // BrhS_1,4.10
transliteration:
uttare syāc caturthe tu sasākṣijayapatrakam /
ṛṇādikeṣu kāryeṣu kalpayen mānuṣīṃ kriyām //
sph_interpretive_translation: In the northern direction, in the fourth division, with witness, victory, and documents, in matters concerning debt and similar obligations, one should establish human action.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in directional and temporal alignment with conscious witnessing
Causation is established through documented evidence and witnessed intent
Capacity-based responsibility arises from engagement in contractual or obligatory relations
Restoration logic operates through re-establishment of rightful energetic and material balance
Consciousness alignment requires acknowledgment of truth through testimony and record
executable_legal_axioms: IF a contractual obligation involves debt THEN evidence must include witness, documentation, and directional/spatial context
IF dispute arises in ṛṇādi matters THEN resolution MUST invoke sasākṣi (with witness) protocol
IF jaya (victory/claim) is asserted THEN it MUST be substantiated by patrakam (written instrument)
IF kārya (matter) pertains to financial or energetic exchange THEN mānuṣī kriyā (human action) shall be initiated for realignment
IF spatial-temporal markers (uttare caturthe) align THEN legal capacity is activated for adjudication
supreme_court_application: Supreme Court adjudication must verify that all ṛṇādi disputes are resolved only when supported by triadic validation: witness presence, written proof, and directional/spatial attestation. No abstract or symbolic interpretation overrides this tripartite requirement rooted in pramāṇa.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Nyāya is fulfilled when pramāṇa confirms the sequential manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ) of obligation through witness, document, and spatial alignment. Responsibility is proportional to the clarity of these validations. No punitive measure applies—only restoration of integrity through reconnection to truth-bearing instruments.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate SakshiDarshan process: summon all witnesses to reaffirm factual alignment
Execute PatraPunarYojana: reconstruct original documents to restore transactional clarity
Perform DigVinishchaya Sadhana: align disputants with directional energy fields to stabilize consciousness
Undertake RnaSamatva Kriya: recalibrate energetic exchange between parties to neutralize imbalance
Apply ManushiKarma Sthapana: facilitate corrective human action that restores dharmic flow
final_declaration: This law proceeds from the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority. Dharma is hereby restored through alignment with witness, word, and space. Reality remains non-punitive; consciousness alone adjudicates. All else follows.
